result.instructions: Tools for Bokadirekt, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which bookings do we have tomorrow, and which staff member is booked for each?"; "Show the sales and payments for last week, per location."; "How many customers gave consent to SMS, and how many are in each city?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Bokadirekt data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run bokadirekt_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run bokadirekt_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run bokadirekt_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. bokadirekt_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: bokadirekt_list_salons
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the locations of your salon (the API calls them salons). Each has a salonId that bookings, staff, products and sales reference. Good first call. GET /api/v1/salons.

tools.name: bokadirekt_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: List the legal entities (companies) that own products and issue receipts, with organisation number and whether product inventory is enabled. GET /api/v1/companies.

tools.name: bokadirekt_list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List the bookable services of the salon, with their ids and whether each is an add-on. GET /api/v1/services.

tools.name: bokadirekt_list_resources
tools.title: List staff (resources)
tools.description: List the bookable staff members (resources) with their location, online-booking flag, availability and price list. Takes an optional date range. GET /api/v1/resources.

StartDate.description: Start of the range, inclusive, ISO 8601 in UTC. Defaults to 30 days before now.

EndDate.description: End of the range, exclusive, ISO 8601 in UTC. Defaults to tomorrow. At most 365 days after StartDate.

tools.name: bokadirekt_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List the salon's customers with name, contact details, consent flags, city and birthday. The national ID is never returned. GET /api/v1/customers returns the full list in one response.

tools.name: bokadirekt_list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: List bookings in a date range: customer, staff, service, time, price, cancelled, no-show and online flags. Filter by scheduled start (0, default) or by creation time (1). At most 365 days per request. GET /api/v1/bookings.

StartDate.description: Start of the range, inclusive, ISO 8601 in UTC. Defaults to 30 days before now.

EndDate.description: End of the range, exclusive, ISO 8601 in UTC. Defaults to tomorrow. At most 365 days after StartDate.

FilterDateType.description: Which date the range applies to: 0 = scheduled start (default), 1 = creation time.

tools.name: bokadirekt_list_sales
tools.title: List sales
tools.description: List sales receipts in a date range, with their rows and payments. At most 365 days per request. GET /api/v1/sales.

StartDate.description: Start of the range, inclusive, ISO 8601 in UTC. Defaults to 30 days before now.

EndDate.description: End of the range, exclusive, ISO 8601 in UTC. Defaults to tomorrow. At most 365 days after StartDate.

tools.name: bokadirekt_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List the salon's retail products with supplier, barcode and stock per location. Read-only; stock is not changed here. GET /api/v1/products.
